notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Derevi.
description:
Create a token copy of Derevi.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Derevi copy.
Put either Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
